{{short description|Japanese mathematician}}
[[File:Shioda tetsuji.jpg|thumb|Tetsuji Shioda, [[Oberwolfach Research Institute for Mathematics|Oberwolfach]] 2005]]
'''Tetsuji Shioda''' (塩田 徹治) was a Japanese mathematician who introduced [[Shioda modular surface]]s and who used [[Mordell–Weil lattice]]s to give examples of dense [[sphere packing]]s. He was an invited speaker at the [[International Congress of Mathematicians|ICM]] in 1990.
